cards.target: Eu gostaria que você estivesse aqui.
cards.english: I wish you were here.

cards.target: Eu queria que as coisas fossem mais simples.
cards.english: I wished things were simpler.

cards.target: Eu te mandei uma mensagem, viu?
cards.english: I sent you a message, okay?

cards.target: Se nós pudéssemos, ficaríamos mais tempo.
cards.english: If we could, we'd stay longer.

cards.target: Eu queria que o mundo fosse mais justo.
cards.english: I wish the world were more just.

cards.target: É recomendável beber bastante água.
cards.english: It's recommended to drink plenty of water.

cards.target: Se eu tivesse coragem, pediria demissão.
cards.english: If I had the courage, I'd resign.

cards.target: Era como se o tempo tivesse parado.
cards.english: It was as if time had stopped.

cards.target: Se nós fizéssemos exercícios, teríamos mais energia.
cards.english: If we exercised, we'd have more energy.

cards.target: Eles pediram que eu trouxesse o documento.
cards.english: They asked me to bring the document.

cards.target: Os documentos foram enviados por e-mail ontem.
cards.english: The documents were sent by email yesterday.

cards.target: Eu queria que a noite durasse para sempre.
cards.english: I wish the night would last forever.

cards.target: Ele costuma almoçar no mesmo restaurante.
cards.english: He usually has lunch at the same restaurant.

cards.target: Se eu fosse você, aceitaria a proposta.
cards.english: If I were you, I'd accept the proposal.

cards.target: Se ele estudasse mais, tiraria notas melhores.
cards.english: If he studied more, he'd get better grades.

cards.target: Se eu pudesse escolher, moraria em Florianópolis.
cards.english: If I could choose, I'd live in Florianópolis.

cards.target: Gostaria que houvesse mais opções de transporte.
cards.english: I'd like there to be more transportation options.

cards.target: Gostaria que você viesse ao meu casamento.
cards.english: I'd like you to come to my wedding.

cards.target: Se eu pudesse consertar o passado, consertaria.
cards.english: If I could fix the past, I would.

cards.target: O carro foi roubado durante a madrugada.
cards.english: The car was stolen during the early morning.

cards.target: Eu queria que ele viesse à minha festa.
cards.english: I wish he would come to my party.

cards.target: Se vocês chegassem mais cedo, pegariam menos trânsito.
cards.english: If you arrived earlier, you'd hit less traffic.

cards.target: Se eu fosse mais corajoso, falaria com ela.
cards.english: If I were braver, I'd talk to her.

cards.target: Se eu conseguisse um emprego melhor, me mudaria.
cards.english: If I got a better job, I'd move.

cards.target: Se ele viesse de avião, chegaria mais rápido.
cards.english: If he came by plane, he'd arrive faster.

cards.target: Eu pedi que ele trouxesse os documentos assinados.
cards.english: I asked him to bring the signed documents.

cards.target: Se ele me convidasse, eu iria com prazer.
cards.english: If he invited me, I'd go with pleasure.

cards.target: Se eu não tivesse compromisso, ficaria mais tempo.
cards.english: If I didn't have plans, I'd stay longer.

cards.target: Se ela não estivesse grávida, viajaria de avião.
cards.english: If she weren't pregnant, she'd travel by plane.

cards.target: Se eu fosse mais velho, teria mais experiência.
cards.english: If I were older, I'd have more experience.

cards.target: O quadro foi pintado por um artista local.
cards.english: The painting was done by a local artist.

cards.target: Se eu fosse rico, doaria para instituições de caridade.
cards.english: If I were rich, I'd donate to charities.

cards.target: Se eu pudesse, ficaria em casa o dia todo.
cards.english: If I could, I'd stay home all day.

cards.target: Se nós soubéssemos a verdade, agiríamos de outra forma.
cards.english: If we knew the truth, we'd act differently.

cards.target: Eu gostaria que ele levasse o trabalho mais a sério.
cards.english: I'd like him to take work more seriously.

cards.target: Se ela tivesse mais tempo, estudaria mais.
cards.english: If she had more time, she would study more.

cards.target: Se eu pudesse, viajaria o mundo inteiro.
cards.english: If I could, I would travel around the world.

cards.target: Ele agiu como se estivesse com pressa.
cards.english: He acted as if he were in a hurry.

cards.target: Se eu comprasse aquele apartamento, ficaria endividado.
cards.english: If I bought that apartment, I'd be in debt.

cards.target: Se eu pudesse recomeçar, escolheria outra carreira.
cards.english: If I could start over, I'd choose another career.

cards.target: Se nós morássemos na praia, seríamos mais felizes.
cards.english: If we lived on the beach, we'd be happier.

cards.target: Ele correu como se a vida dependesse disso.
cards.english: He ran as if his life depended on it.

cards.target: Era como se ela não existisse para ele.
cards.english: It was as if she didn't exist to him.

cards.target: Se eu tivesse um jardim, plantaria árvores frutíferas.
cards.english: If I had a garden, I'd plant fruit trees.

cards.target: Se nós tivéssemos mais recursos, expandiríamos o negócio.
cards.english: If we had more resources, we'd expand the business.

cards.target: Se eu falasse francês, me candidataria àquela vaga.
cards.english: If I spoke French, I'd apply for that position.

cards.target: Se ela não fosse tão ocupada, sairíamos mais.
cards.english: If she weren't so busy, we'd go out more.

cards.target: Se ele fosse mais comunicativo, faria mais amizades.
cards.english: If he were more communicative, he'd make more friends.

cards.target: Se o tempo estivesse melhor, faríamos um piquenique.
cards.english: If the weather were better, we'd have a picnic.

cards.target: Se eu tivesse mais coragem, mudaria de vida.
cards.english: If I had more courage, I'd change my life.

cards.target: Se eu tivesse começado antes, já teria terminado.
cards.english: If I had started earlier, I'd already be done.

cards.target: Se eu fosse presidente, investiria em energia renovável.
cards.english: If I were president, I'd invest in renewable energy.

cards.target: Se a internet funcionasse, eu poderia trabalhar de casa.
cards.english: If the internet worked, I could work from home.

cards.target: Se a gente tivesse um quintal, plantaria uma horta.
cards.english: If we had a backyard, we'd plant a garden.

cards.target: Se não fosse tão longe, eu iria a pé.
cards.english: If it weren't so far, I'd go on foot.

cards.target: Se ele tivesse parado de fumar antes, estaria mais saudável.
cards.english: If he had quit smoking earlier, he'd be healthier.

cards.target: Se não fosse pela tecnologia, a comunicação seria mais difícil.
cards.english: If it weren't for technology, communication would be harder.

cards.target: Se eu fizesse dieta, perderia peso rapidamente.
cards.english: If I went on a diet, I'd lose weight quickly.

cards.target: Se não chovesse tanto, o trânsito seria melhor.
cards.english: If it didn't rain so much, traffic would be better.

cards.target: Seria bom se a gente se visse mais.
cards.english: It would be nice if we saw each other more.

existing_tips: Future passive: 'será/serão + participle' – the participle still agrees with the subject in gender a
'Entregues' agrees in gender and number with the subject 'documentos'.
